description: Search bookable surf lessons on SurfBooking by free-text query (zone, beach, level, activity), with optional structured filters (level, maxPrice, date range). Returns upcoming lessons with date, time, spot, level, school, price and a booking link, and says how many matched. All times are local Europe/Lisbon. SurfBooking zones with schools only: Portugal (14 zones with schools), Spain (1 zone with schools). Read-only — does not book or charge anything. It returns lessons, not a ranking of where the surf is good right now. Great for 'aulas de surf na Ericeira', 'beginner lessons this weekend' or 'surf lesson under 40 euros'. This is the general search by place, level, date and price; it does not filter by what the sea is doing, and it does not search hotels.

maxPrice.description: Optional — only lessons at or below this price in EUR, e.g. 50.

query.description: Free text in Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, German or Italian, e.g. 'beginner Carcavelos', 'aulas iniciante Ericeira', 'kurs morgen Ericeira' or 'cours debutant Peniche'. Min 2 chars.
